tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le'i gsang sgrub lha lnga'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga gsal ba'i sgron me bzhugs so// ༄༅// pad+ma rā ga'i lhun brtsegs ye shes sku// 'dzum pa'i bzhin gyi rtse dgas rgod pa snyam// mdzes sdug lang tshos 'gro kun yid rab 'phrog /de wī rig byed ma yis dge legs stsol// 'dir ḍom+bi he ru ka nas brgyud pa'i rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le gsang sgrub lha lnga'i byin rlabs la maṇ+ḍal sogs kyi gzhi la/ rdul tshon dmar pos pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar rdul tshon nam sin+dhu ra'i chos 'byung*/ de'i nang pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar hrīḥ shar gyi 'dab ba la ha/ lhor ri/ nub tu ni/ byang du sa bris/ bsdu na/ tshom bu lngas kyang chog de'i g.yas su'am/ steng du bu ram sogs btab pa'i thod chang*/ bum pa dri bzang gi chu kha rgyan dang bcas pa/ dung chos rdor gzungs mi dgos/ ut+pal/ mda' gzhu/ lcags kyu/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan rnams bsham/ mdun du zlum gtor dmar po gcig chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga yang bsham/ slob dpon gyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas nas/ skad cig gis rang ku ru kul+ler gsal ba'i snying ga'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma 'od dpag med kyis gtso mo'i dbur brgyan pa'i rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le lha lnga la sangs rgyas byang sems kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ shrī ku ru kul+le maṇ+ḍa le bh+yaḥ zhes pas phyag bya/ na mo gu ru shrī ku ru kul+le maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da rnams la mgor na mo gu ru sogs dang*/ mjug tu pra tīts+tsha swā hā sbyar bas mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/

snang srid thams cad stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba drwa ba gur dang bcas pa'i phyi rol tu ye shes kyi me phung 'bar zhing 'khrugs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ srung 'khor gyi dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa/ de'i lte bar ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du dbang phyug chen po dang lha mo u ma bsnol ba'i steng du/ rā hu la nag po rwa'i mda' gzhu can gyis mnan pa/ phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi la ro gdan re re/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du hri'aḥdamar po las ut+pal dmar po hrīḥs mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad la phog sems can thams cad rje btsun mar gyur/ tshur 'dus ut+pa lar thim pas rang rje btsun ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas dang po lcags kyu/ g.yon dang po ut+pal 'dzin pa rna ba'i thad dkar kha bye ba/ 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che'i mda' dang gzhu sbyar te rna ba g.yas pa'i drung du 'gengs pa/ spyan gsum pa skra ser po gyen tu brdzes pa/ zhal mche ba cung zad gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ 'dzum khro'i tshul can/ phyag rgya lnga dang ldan zhing*/ stag gi pags pa rlon pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang pa'i gar stabs kyis dbang phyug dang u ma dang sgra gcan mnan pa/ me ri 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i mthar mkha' 'gro ma bzhi ni/ shar du ha las rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo/ lhor ri las rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo/ nub tu ni las pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo/ byang du sa las las kyi mkha' 'gro ma ljang gu/ bzhi ka'ang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas ḍa ma ru dang g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ gcer bu spyan gsum ma/ ral pa thur du 'phyangs pa/ sgeg pa'i nyams can gru mo na kha ṭ+wām̐ ga yod pa/

zhabs g.yas brkyang pa'i stabs kyis ro mnan pa'o// gtso mo'i spyi bor hrīḥlas rta mgrin dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis dbyug pa dang sdigs mdzub can/ dbu'i steng na rta mgo ljang gu rta skad 'tsher bas khams gsum dbang du sdud pa khro bo'i rgyan can/ de'i thugs kar hrīḥ de'i spyi bor bla ma he ru ka rang gi snying gar pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i lte bar hrīḥlas ut+pa la hrīḥs mtshan pa la ye shes sems dpa' gtso mo 'khor mkha' 'gro ma bzhi dang bcas pa bsam/ gtso mo'i thugs kar pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i steng du hrīḥ 'dab ma bzhi dang phyi nang gi lha mo brgyad kyi thugs kar yang ha ri ni sa so sor bsam/ lha de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po sogs/ thugs ka'i dbus su gnas pa'i rang gi sa bon hrīḥsogs las 'od zer 'phros/ lho phyogs kyi ku ru kul+le'i phug dang rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun ma gtso 'khor lnga la sangs rgyas byang sems kyis bskor ba spyan drangs te/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs rang la bstim/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang lha 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso mo la 'od dpag med/ he ru ka dang*/ 'khor rnams la gtso mo nyid kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ ku ru kul+le sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nas shab+da'i bar gyis phyi mchod dang*/ nang mchod nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi myang*/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs kyis yid mchod kyang bya/ brtse bas rjes chags pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis mdzes pa'i sku// mda' gzhu ut+pal lcags kyu zhags pa bsnams// rje btsun rig byed ma la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/

rang gi snying ga'i hrīḥyig dmar po'i mtha' skor du yi ge bcu gnyis pa'i sngags byi ru'i phreng ba lta bu las 'od zer dmar po bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad la phog pas dbang du gyur/ 'od zer rnams tshur 'dus snying ga'i hrīḥdang sngags phreng la thim pa'i dmigs pa yang yang gsal gdab pa'i ngang nas/ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥha ri ni sa swā hā/ brgya rtsa la sogs pa bzla/ bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor dang bcas pas snod bcud thams cad dbang du 'dus par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod/ 'khor bzhi rang la bsdu/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /ku ru kul+le 'grub gyur nas// zhes sogs brjod/ de nas mdun bskyed kyi rten rnams la dmigs te/ oṃ shū n+ya tā sogs brjod/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje zhes pa nas/ gtso 'khor lnga yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed pa dang phyi nang yid mchod bstod pa rnams sngar bzhin la/ mdun bskyed la gtso mo bskyed pa na rang zhes mi sbyar/ gtor ma dang thod chang la dmigs te bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rlung dang me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du thod pa'i sgyed bu gsum/ de'i steng du a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i dbus su go ku da ha na las sha lnga/ bi mu shu ma ra las bdud rtsi lnga/ bh+rūm̐ ām̐ dz+rīṃ kham̐ hūm̐ las ye shes lnga/ de'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ dkar dmar mthing gsum mgo thur bstan bsam/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ rlung g.yos me sbar thod pa'i nang gi rdzas rnams zhu zhing bskol/ 'bru gsum las 'od 'phros ku ru kul+le mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug ste thod pa'i nang gi rdzas rnams la thim zhing ro gcig tu 'dres par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥlan gsum gyis byin rlabs la/ yi ge bcu gnyis pa'i sngags kyi mjug tu i daṃ lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/

lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ phyi nang yid mchod bstod pa sngar bzhin/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa bya/ bum pa bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bum pa dkyus bzhin bskyed la/ bum chu'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar hrīḥ 'dab ma bzhi la ro'i steng du ha ri ni sa'i sa bon rnams yongs su gyur pa las dbus su gtso mo dang 'dab ma bzhi la 'khor rnams yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/ phyi nang yid mchod/ bstod pa rnams sngar bzhin/ bum nang gi gtso mo'i thugs kar hrīḥyig gi mthar yi ge bcu gnyis ma'i sngags phreng dang*/ 'khor rnams kyi thugs kar yang rang rang gi sa bon gsal btab la yig 'bru rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ bdag gi thugs ka nas kyang 'od zer 'phros lha rnams kyi sku la phog pas thugs mnyes shing dbang du gyur par bsam/ yi ge bcu gnyis pa brgya rtsa la sogs pa bzla/ mchod bstod sngar bzhin/ dung chos kyi mchod yon dbul ba sogs 'di la med/ bum nang gi lha rnams kyang mi bzhu bar bzhag de nas slob ma kye rdo rje sogs kyi dbang thob pa bos la/ sems can thams cad kyi don du zhes pa nas gsan par zhu 'tshal/ gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni/ gangs can bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams la bla med kyi gdams pa rgya mtsho lta bu bka' babs pa'i nang nas 'dir thun mong bsgrubs pas mchog zhal las 'byung ba dmar po skor gsum gyi nang tshan rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le 'di kye rdo rje'i rgyud 'bum phrag lnga pa dang*/ brtag pa gnyis pa nas gsal bar gsungs shing*/ 'di la rgyal po lhan skyes rol pa nas brgyud pa'i phyi sgrub gtso kyang dpa' bo gcig par grags pa dang*/ klu sgrub nas brgyud pa'i nang sgrub lha lnga dang*/ ḍom+bi he ru ka nas brgyud pa'i gsang sgrub lha lnga rnams las/ nang sgrub la sgrub thabs gdams pa'i rim pa cha tshang bar yod kyang byin rlabs kyi cho ga bshad tshod med/

gtso rkyang dang gsang sgrub la byin rlabs kyi bka' ma nub par bzhugs pa las da lan gsang sgrub lha lnga'i byin rlabs 'bul ba'i skabs yin/ de la sngon 'gro slob dpon gyi bya ba bdag bskyed mdun bskyed bum bskyed rnams grub zin/ dngos gzhi slob ma la bya ba'i ngo skal du gyur pa la/ slob dpon rje btsun ma ku ru kul+ler gsal ba la gsang sgrub lha lnga'i byin rlabs zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can sogs dang*/ rgyun bshags/ rigs lnga'i sdom bzung rnams lan gsum re/ de nas thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pas bdag la rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le'i lha tshogs dbab par mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ slob dpon rje btsun mar gsal ba dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang*/ 'gro ba gzhan ma dad pa'i dri ma rnams byang zhing dag par byas/ lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las pam̐ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i steng na dbang phyug chen po dang lha mo u ma bsnol ba'i steng du sgra gcan gyi snying gar hrīḥdamar po/ 'dab ma bzhi la ro'i gdan re re'i steng du shar du ha/ lhor ri/ nub tu ni/ byang du sa ste sa bon gyi yi ge lnga las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yig 'bru rnams la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du khyed rnams rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le sku mdog dmar mo zhes pa nas/ dpral bar oṃ dkar po sogs gnas gsum byin rlabs kyi bar sngar bzhin/ slob dpon yang rje btsun ma dngos yin snyam pa'i gus 'dud gnang bas/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/

phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs kar phog thugs rgyud bskul/ thams cad kyang rje btsun ma'i rnam par byon pa dang*/ khyad par lho phyogs kyi ri ku ru kul+le'i phug nas rje btsun ma gtso 'khor lnga bsam gyis mi khyab par byon/ mdun bskyed las kyang gtso 'khor lnga dpag tu med pa chad de/ de thams cad khyed rang rnams kyi sku lus la sib sib thim pas thugs rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa yin snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ dril gsil rol chen dang bcas pa bya zhing*/ yi ge bcu gnyis pa'i sngags kyi mthar ā we sha ya aḥ.āḥ zhes brjod/ yang slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas rje btsun ma dang bcas pa'i gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad sngags phreng kha dog dmar po'i rnam pa can dpag tu med par spyan drangs/ sngar ltar bstims la rol chen dang sngags brjod/ yang thugs 'dun 'di bzhin gnang bar zhu/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas dang*/ rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs kyi byin rlabs dang nus mthu thams cad lcags kyu dang*/ zhags pa dang*/ mda' gzhu la sogs pa phyag mtshan dpag tu med pa'i rnam par spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi smin mtshams kyi thad kyi nam mkhar sleb pa dang*/ 'od dmar po bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du mer gyis zhu nas sku lus la sib sib thim pas thugs rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa gnang bar zhu/ rol chen bya zhing sngags brjod/ yang slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros/ snod bcud thams cad la phog 'od dmar por zhu/ 'od thams cad tshur 'dus khyed rang gi sku lus la sib sib thim pas dbang du byas pa'i mos pa gnang bar zhu/ de nas rje btsun ma'i phyag mtshan mda' gzhu lag tu gtad de rjes su gnang ba byin par mos pa mdzod/

thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin mda' gzhu yi// mi shes nad sel ma rig 'bigs par bya// ut+pal dang lcags kyu byin te/ ut+pal mdzes pa lha mo'i phyag mtshan nyid// de ring bu khyod la ni sbyin par bya// 'khor ba'i 'dam nas 'gro ba 'dren mdzad pa// rgyal ba'i phyag mtshan lcags kyu 'di zungs shig /rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan gtad de/ rdo rje 'khor lo rin po che// pad+ma rdo rje rgya gram rnams// mkha' 'gro rnams kyi phyag mtshan te// de ring khyod kyis bzung bar bya// mkha' 'gros rtag tu byin rlob 'gyur// oṃ sarba ḍā ki nī a bhi ṣiñtsa sarba ta thā ga ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ de nas khyed rang rje btsun ma gtso 'khor lngar gsal ba'i 'khor gyi lha mo bzhi gtso mo la thim/ khyed rang gtso mo rkyang par gsal ba'i mda' gzhu rna ba'i drung du 'gengs par mos te/ snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer dmar po dpag tu med pa 'phros/ rna ba g.yas nas thon mda'i ltong nas zhugs/ ut+pal dmar po'i mde'u nas thon/ klu gnod sbyin mi'i 'jig rten thams cad la phog pas dmar lam sor nas 'od du zhu/ thams cad tshur 'dus mde'u nas yar zhugs/ ltong nas thon/ khyed rang gi rna ba g.yas nas zhugs/ snying gar thim pas thams cad dbang du 'dus pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags kyi bzlas lung gi slad du thugs 'dun 'di bzhin gnang bar zhu/ slob dpon rje btsun mar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sngags phreng las sngags phreng rim pa gsum 'phros zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams rje btsun mar gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i hrīḥyig gi mthar sngags phreng dang po 'khod/ gnyis pa dang gsum pa de la thim pas thugs rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ yi ge bcu gnyis pa'i rjes zlos lan gsum/ bcom ldan bdag la sogs dang*/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs dkyus bzhin/ thod chang lag tu gtad tsam bya/ slar bdud rtsi khyor bar sbyin cing 'thung du gzhug la/

bla ma dang rje btsun ma'i lha tshogs rnams kyis dngos grub sbyin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bum pa spyi bor bzhag la/ bum nang gi lha mo gtso 'khor lnga bzhugs pa'i sku lus las bdud rtsi dmar po babs pas/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag dngos grub thams cad thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bum chu sbyin/ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥha ri ni sa swā hā a bhi ṣiñtsa zhes brjod/ de ltar dbang bskur bas chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ de nas sin+dhū ra'i maṇ+ḍal gyi yig 'bru lnga slob dpon gyi srin lag g.yon pas blangs te slob ma'i gnas gsum du thig le bya/ mdun bskyed kyi lha mo gtso 'khor lnga khyed rang rnams kyi lus la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gong du tshom bu las ma bkod na/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis cung zad re blangs la gnas gsum du mtshon pa re bzhag la/ mdun bskyed kyi gtso 'khor lnga slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum la thim par bsam/ rjes gtso bos sogs 'dra/ de nas slob dpon gyis bum nang gi lha tshogs la mchod bstod sngar bzhin bya/ yig brgya dang nongs pa bzod gsol bya/ bum nang gi ye shes pa la gshegs gsol dang*/ dam tshig pa rang la bstim/ sin+dhū ra'i gtso 'khor lnga slob ma la bstims tshar bas des chog sin+dhū ra'i lhag ma rnams tshag bya zhing*/ las kyi rjes bsdu/ dge ba bsngo/ shis pa brjod/ 'di la byin rlabs kyi cho ga tshigs bcad ma dang*/ bla ma mnyam med chen po dang*/ so 'jig rten grags pas mdzad pa sogs yig rigs mi 'dra ba kha yar 'dug mod/ phal cher lhan skyes rol pa nas mdzad pa'i phyi sgrub gtso rkyang la sbyar ba 'dra ste/ sos mdzad pa las lhan skyes rol par brgyud pa byas 'dug pa dang*/ so dang mnyam med chen po gnyis kas gsung bzlas lung gi rjes la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i nus mthu bsdu ba dang*/

gang la thog ma dbus mtha' sogs brjod pa dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi rten la pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su hrīḥtsam las mi 'bri ba dang*/ mdun bskyed bum bskyed la bcom ldan 'das ma bskyed ces pa tsam las 'khor ma bskyed pas phyi sgrub dpa' mo gcig pa rang gi byin rlabs la thugs rtse gtad 'dug cing*/ mig dar dang me tog lha ngo bstan pa rnams ni kha che paṇa chen nas sa paṇa la brgyud pa'i ku ru kul+le lha lnga'i dbang nas kha bskangs 'dug pas gsang sgrub 'di'i khungs su mi 'gro'o// des na 'di'i bdag bskyed dang mdun bskyed ni gsang sgrub thun mong ma yin pa'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gcig tu dril ba'i man ngag bzhin bkod/ byin rlabs ni rig byed ma'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge rnying pa la brten nas 'os dpyad dang rang bzo spangs nas phyag len yang dag par bgyis so// sna tshogs yi ge'i chu dang 'o ma'i tshogs// 'dres pa 'dab bzang dbang po'i mchu yis bzhin// so sor 'byed nus gang de mkhas pa yin// gang yang don dpyod med na blun por bas// e ma 'di 'dra'i phyag bzhes za ma tog /zad mi shes pa nam mkha'i mdzod bzhin tu// ji snyed shes mod snyigs ma'i dus 'di na// gzur gnas legs bshad len pa nyin skar tsam// bla ma'i byin rlabs snying dbus pad mor zhugs// dag dang ma dag 'byed pa'i blo nus thob// mkhas mang rgol bas lan brgyar bsdigs na yang*// mi 'jigs spobs pa'i gdong mig gyen la mtho// zhes pa 'di ni dge slong sde snod gsum pa ngag dbang chos grags kyis shing mo glang gi lo zla ba bdun pa'i yar tshes bdun gyi nyin/ dpal rtse gdong phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i chos grwar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chos grags bzang po'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/

bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
